rejected_rule.statement: The burden of proof for prescriptive title under the Prescription Ordinance lies with the co-owner who seeks to claim prescriptive title against the other co-owners.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: if any person wants to succeed he must meet the requirement of the high order of proof to establish adverse possession and the burden of proof vests entirely upon the co-owner who seeks to claim prescriptive title against the other co-owners.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance No.22 of 1871
